newsitem.title: UK: BA strike plan hits NWE jet fuel cargo spreads.
newsitem.headline: BA strike plan hits NWE jet fuel cargo spreads.

text.p: A planned 72-hour strike by British Airways Plc cabin crew next week cut jet fuel cargo differentials on Wednesday, depressing an already well supplied market, traders said.
One July-loading cargo moved at July IPE +$15.50 cif Copenhagen, some $1.50 under Tuesday's assessed value.
Traders said the plans meant BA in Europe had become a net seller at a time when demand is patchy at best. Barges were assessed notionally at July IPE +$15/16.
July IPE gas oil futures closed 25 cents off at $167.50 a tonne.
